scope: activation-sensitive news semantics are governed by the immutable first-seen clock rather than a later repeat-poll clock

incident.root_cause: Classification occurs before the existing-row lookup. A stable source URL first observed before a prospective rule activated could therefore be classified on a later poll with an activation-eligible flag, after which storage preserved the old first_seen_utc without replaying the new semantics on that original clock.

observed_false_claim.headline: Statement by Chief Pentagon Spokesman, Sean Parnell, on the Clinical Guidance for Health and Human Performance Optimization
observed_false_claim.pre_repair_problem: A later repeat poll could set the prospective defense guard's activation-eligible claim even though the immutable first-seen observation preceded activation. Earlier V154 semantics had also mistaken non-market battlefield boilerplate for a global risk-off event.
observed_false_claim.proof_consequence: No historical observation may acquire prospective standing from a later poll. V154, V155 and V156 representations are diagnostic only and are not governed proof.

incident.second_affected_contract: The same storage path could have allowed a repeated RBNZ official-search URL to inherit structured policy-rate fields after the structured observation contract activated.

implementation.positive_activation_claim_detection: Every true *_activation_eligible flag is paired with its explicit *_activated_utc boundary and compared with the immutable stored first_seen_utc.
implementation.replay_rule: If a positive activation claim predates the immutable first-seen clock, the entire article is reclassified using that original clock before the current representation is stored.
implementation.stable_url_rule: Stable-link lookup also applies to an activation-sensitive structured observation only when its prospective claim would be retroactive; legitimate post-activation versioned releases retain their separate event identities.
implementation.structured_field_rule: Later-poll RBNZ structured numeric fields are removed before pre-activation replay, so actual, previous, parser-contract and structured-event status cannot bootstrap their own eligibility.
implementation.causal_evidence_policy: Raw observations, immutable first-seen clocks and historical classifier lineage remain preserved. Replayed historical rows receive no prospective proof, promotion, authorization or execution credit.

rbnz_pre_activation_row.headline: OCR increased by 25 basis points to 2.75% - rbnz.govt.nz
